dsh-codex-auth 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。复用 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT 登录态注册 `openai-codex` LLM 路由，并在 DSH Web 设置中提供 GPT Auth 控件。

posts.en:
dsh-codex-auth is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Reuses the Codex CLI ChatGPT login as an `openai-codex` LLM route and adds GPT Auth controls to DSH Web settings.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0e82f13823075b68966c.html
